text.text_excerpt: First visit to Toups South and we will definitely return. The Sunday Brunch is fantastic and we are anxious to have more food here. Where to start - nice atmosphere and not too noisy. We had reservations and were seated immediately. Great service and friendly staff. Now for the food - it was all mmmmm good. The table shared an order of biscuits (4 big flaky biscuits) and a cinnamon roll. The cinnamon roll was not traditional and in fact was so delicious that we didn't want to stop eating it. The big plates were truly BIG and delicious. Mine was pastrami, sweet potato hash. It was delicious and easily could have been shared. Lucky me, I brought a big portion home to eat tomorrow. I can pre...

K has been wanting to come over here for a while, so we headed over for brunch to check it out. The bar wasn't too busy, and we settled in for some day drinks and food. They have an "endless mimosa" which was K's choice, I had a few draft beers. The folks at the bar were awesome and fun to chat with. For food, we got an order of cracklings, which should be outlawed they are so good. Seriously, if you are into that, try the ones at Toups. We also got a sourdough biscuit with crab fat butter, and it is RICH. Delicious, but really rich. For main dishes we got the boudin burrito, which was tasty but not that memorable, and their fried chicken sandwich (they're known for it, and with good reas...

Loved this place and it's food. Went in on a Sunday for brunch and was surprised on how quickly we were seated. Our waitress was amazing and even brought us some shots on the house to celebrate our friends birthday. The cracklings are to die for, perfect mixture of crunch, fat and salt! I had the Toups Burger and it was great, cooked to medium rare perfection and accompanied by delicious pommels frites. My friend had the Pastrami Hash which looked delicious and his empty plate confirmed my assumption.
